 ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed seeking issuance of a Writ of Mandamus forbearing the respondents from compelling the petitioner to sign any consent deed for receipt of compensation amounts towards the acquisition of the petitioners lands to an extent of about 16.5 cents (0.11.50 hectares) comprised in Re-Survey No.176/11A and 3.5 cents (0.02.00 hectares) comprised in C.Vasanthi vs The Commissioner Of Land ... on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75153425/
2 Re-Survey No.176/12A, situated at Nallur Village, Vilavancode Taluk, Kanyakumari District and to pass suitable orders to refix/redetermine the proper compensation by strictly adhering to the provisions of Sections 26, 27, 28, 29 and 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, within a time frame as may be fixed by this Court.
2.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that the subject lands were allotted to the petitioner pursuant to a partition deed executed among the legal heirs of the petitioners father.

The Central Government,
as well as the Southern Railway, had decided to extend the double-line railway track from Thiruvananthapuram to Kanyakumari via Kuzhithurai.

However, except for the measurements taken by the revenue authorities, till date, no notice of enquiry has been issued to any of the persons interested, as stipulated under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. The revenue authorities are insisting that the petitioner sign a consent deed which includes the particulars of the petitioners land.
The petitioners sister, whose lands are situated on the southern side of the petitioners lands, was paid compensation at the rate of Rs.9,690/- per sq. metre.

In the communication addressed to the petitioners sister, details relating to the compensation determined for the lands belonging to the petitioner were also mentioned, which are much lower than the compensation paid to the petitioners sister.
_ _ _ ______ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
5. The revenue authorities, without following the due procedure, have fixed the compensation arbitrarily.

Therefore, the petitioner submitted a representation dated 22.08.2025 to the first,
second and eighth respondents seeking proper determination of compensation for the lands sought to be acquired.
However, no response has been received from them.
Hence, the petitioner has been constrained to file the present Writ Petition.

6. The learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the first, second and fifth to eighth respondents, on instructions, would submit that notice would be issued to the petitioner and that all the procedures laid down for the acquisition of lands and for fixation of compensation would be duly followed.

7. Recording the above submission and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter,
a direction is issued to the respondents to follow all the procedures laid down for the acquisition of land and for fixation of compensation in the acquisition proceedings.
Any continuation of further proceedings without following the due procedure would be impermissible.
